_doc: G3: static/native-tier components that have no cascivo-html emitter or parity case yet. Key: unit name. The list may only shrink: an entry whose component gained an emitter, case and PARITY_COMPONENTS row fails as stale.

entries.dashboard-layout: React takes stats/main/aside as three props; .cv fills the slots from child order, so a case would pin the mapping rather than the markup. Follow-up with named-slot grammar.
entries.masonry: Column packing is measured at runtime by the React component; a static emitter would need a no-JS fallback design (CSS columns) agreed first.
entries.settings-layout: Composes a nav rail plus routed panels from props objects; the .cv grammar has no object-prop syntax for them yet.
entries.auth-layout: Takes brand, form and aside as ReactNode slots; needs the same named-slot grammar as dashboard-layout.
